attributes.title: Junior Client Success Manager
attributes.description:
• Fluent written and spoken English. Our clients are US doctors. You will write to them and speak with them every day.
  • You own outcomes. You have handled client relationships and can tell us what you kept, what you lost and why. Haven't owned a client book yet? tell us honestly.
  • You bring bad news early, with a plan. You do not wait to be asked.
  • You write clearly and fast. If your writing needs a second pass to be understood, this is the wrong seat.
  • You can hold a doctor's respect. Calm, direct, prepared, unbothered by pushback.
  • You live in AI tools. You useClaude or similar every day, can show us how, and pick up new tools fast. This matters more to us than your resume.

You do not need to be a GoHighLevel expert on day one, but you must learn fast and be willing to build. You need to work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, with your camera on.

Skunks on the table

Every line is true. If one makes you want to close the tab, that is useful for both of us. If they make you lean in, you are probably who we are looking for.

  • This is a fully remote position. If you do not have a quiet, productive place to work from home with reliable power and internet, this is not the right role for you.
  • Going quiet is the one thing that does not work here. Missed a deadline? Tell us. Stuck? Say "I hit a wall." Problems get named the same day, in the open.
  • No recipe, and the structure keeps moving. We are "building the plane while flying it," and pods, seats and clients change as we grow. The first 2 to 3 weeks are quiet. The people who thrive start digging before anyone asks.
  • The CEO is direct. Plain feedback, expected back. He loves being challenged and hates silence.
  • Doctors push back, and quality beats volume. Our clients are smart, busy and spending their own money, so you hold your ground with evidence. A cheap lead who cannot afford a $4,000 treatment is not a win. Compliance is non-negotiable: no guarantees, no definitive claims.
  • You are the last set of eyes. Errors that should have been caught in QA come out of the pod's bonus pool, just as retention and expansion grow it.

Our values: give a shit · better before bigger · sincere candor · move fast and fix it · prove it works · unimpeachable character.
attributes.projects:
WANTED! The BEST Remote Junior Client Success Manager In The World

To apply, answer the questions in the application form. One of them asks you to type exactly: "I actually read the instructions."

Most account managers forward emails and read reports out loud on calls. We are not looking for that person. Our clients are doctors who own cash-pay medical clinics. We are looking for the person they call first: the one who spots the problem before they do, tells them before they ask, and shows up with the fix already moving.

Who we are: a US-based growth consultancy for cash-pay medical practices. Our website says it plainly: marketing agencies suck, so we built Guidepost to be the exception. We run Meta and Google ads into funnels built in GoHighLevel, and every piece of work ties back to one question: did the clinic make money? You would join a pod (a CSM, a small, lean team with shared support) that owns clients end to end. Monthly client churn is under 1%.
attributes.functions:
• You own the relationship. The doctor emails you, Slacks you and gets on calls with you.
  • You turn requests into work. Every client ask becomes a ClickUp task the team can act on without a follow-up question, with the why attached. "Build a new landing page" is not a brief. "The heatmap shows people stop scrolling before the CTA, so the CTA moves above the fold" is. When it is something you can build, you build it.
  • You narrate the numbers. In two minutes, in plain English: what is working, what is not, and what is next.
  • You catch problems first. The client never discovers an issue we have not already told them about.
  • You spot the next win. Not a pitch. Arithmetic out loud with the client's own numbers until the next step is obvious.

This is not a messenger seat: from day one you also build GoHighLevel automations, workflows and landing pages, using AI to move fast. And if all you do on a call is read a report, you are not doing the job.

What a good month looks like

  • Every client request became a ClickUp task with enough context that nobody had to come back to you to ask what it meant.
  • You ran the client calls yourself. The CEO was not on them.
  • You built or fixed automations, workflows or pages yourself instead of leaving them in someone else's queue.
  • Your pod's daily client updates went out accurate, because you read them before they shipped and corrected the one that was wrong.
  • No client surprised anyone with a problem, and no client cancelled without the risk being visible weeks earlier.
  • You brought at least one expansion case built on a client's real numbers, or explained why the timing was wrong.

How we work

  • Reply to clients within 1 business hour, even if it is "got it, looking into it," with a real answer or a timeline within 24. Reply to internal Slack within 10 minutes.
  • Decisions live on the ClickUp task or in the client channel. Never in DMs.
  • Monday all-hands, 9:00 to 10:30 AM Eastern.

Want to create a greener future for our cities?

Our vision is a future of affordable mobility services which support the environment. A transformation is taking place across our cities and, with Forest, we can all start building a healthier & more sustainable future for our urban communities.

Forest is a fast-growing and innovative micro-mobility company with a global team making transport more sustainable and affordable for London travellers. We combine easy to use micro-mobility solutions with a unique marketing platform to make rides cheaper and greener for our users and partners.

Our Values

Put People First

Our people are what makes forest forest. So we listen with care, lead with kindness and create a safe space where everyone can show up as their authentic self, being treated equally, respectfully and with no judgement. We do the right thing - for our employees and our users - even when no one is watching.

Build Together
We can’t do this alone. We believe in collaboration, transparency and keeping each other in the loop, even when the news is tough. We ask for help when we need it and enjoy supporting others. We're not afraid to hire people better than ourselves and celebrate strengths different to our own.

Inspire Trust
We trust people with autonomy and empower them to work in a way that enables their best performance. We give and encourage candid feedback and treat mistakes not as reasons for blame, but as opportunities to learn, grow, and strengthen how we work together.

Take Ownership

attributes.title: Back-end Software Engineer
attributes.description:
For us, Senior isn’t a matter of years or of how many technologies you know. It’s how you work:

  • You understand the problem before you solve it. You ask what the business or user actually needs, and sometimes the right answer is not to build anything.
  • You choose the simplest solution that works.
  • To you, complexity is a cost.
  • You make trade-offs explicit and explain your reasoning.
  • You own outcomes, not tasks.
  • You surface risks early, say when a plan is no longer realistic, and see things through after release.
  • You build things others can maintain.
  • Your code is clear, tested and easy to evolve without you in the room.
  • You think about what can go wrong. Failing dependencies, bad data, security and performance are part of the design, not an afterthought.
  • You act like a consultant.
  • You adapt how you communicate to engineers, product and clients, and you bring recommendations, not only problems.
  • You make your team better. You give thoughtful reviews, share what you know and help others grow, without becoming a bottleneck.
  • You keep learning. You get productive in unfamiliar systems and know when to ask for help.
  • You use AI responsibly. It makes you faster, but you understand and validate everything before it ships.
  • 4+ years building backends with Python and Django (Django REST Framework a big plus)
  • Solid experience with PostgreSQL in production, including schema changes on live systems
  • Hands-on experience with background processing (Celery, RabbitMQ, Redis or similar)
  • You’ve built and maintained integrations with third-party APIs and know what happens when they fail
  • You care about testing, code quality and constructive code reviews
  • You’ve supported your own work in production: monitoring, debugging and incidents don’t scare you
  • You’re comfortable in a large codebase shared with many engineers
  • C1 English: you’ll work daily with a US-based team, in meetings and in writing

Our team consists of over 90 dedicated professionals across 9 different countries, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and collaboration. We prioritize continuous learning and improvement, ensuring that our employees are equipped with the skills needed to thrive in a rapidly changing tech landscape. Joining us as a Senior QA Analyst means becoming part of a passionate group of analysts, designers, and engineers committed to delivering exceptional quality in our products.

You’ll work on the core of that platform: a mature, large-scale Python/Django backend. Real people depend on it, so the job is more than writing code. You’ll solve real business problems, make sound technical decisions and own the outcome from the first conversation to a reliable release.

  • Evolve the database of a live product without interrupting the people who rely on it

attributes.description:
• 8+ years building and operating production web applications end to end, backend-weighted, with a track record of owning systems rather than tickets.
  • Strong Python in production. FastAPI is what we use; Django, Flask or similar is fine if you can move across.

  • Hands-on experience getting LLM-backed systems into production: agent or graph orchestration, RAG, prompt and context design, and evaluating model output rather than trusting it.
  • Fluent daily use of Claude Code or an equivalent agentic coding tool, with a clear view of where it helps and where it doesn't.
  • Production experience on a major cloud. We are on AWS: containers, background jobs, secrets, logs, and debugging things that only break in prod.

  • Documentation creation that let someone else pick the work up.
  • Professional English
  • Connection during LATAM (Chile) Business hours

STACK:
attributes.projects: BNamericas operates the leading business intelligence platform for Latin America’s infrastructure, mining, and energy projects. At the core of everything we publish is a research operation supported by large-scale internal systems: continuous data collection from public and private sources, validation by our team, and delivery into content production for publication. We are rebuilding this platform end-to-end, and AI is embedded across the workflow—so the product is not an add-on, but part of the system’s foundation. As a senior engineer, you’ll help turn expert know-how into resilient product capabilities the team can scale.
attributes.functions:
Behind BNamericas is an internal platform that continuously collects data from hundreds of public and private sources, routes it to our research team for verification, and moves it through to publication.

We are rebuilding that platform with AI at its core. You'll own features end to end, from schema to interface, and help turn knowledge held by a few people into a system the whole team can carry. Small team, no ticket factory, and real internal users on what you ship within days.

Product and platform

  • Forms and validation: rich, API-integrated data entry for structured content, and the validation rules that keep ittrustworthy.
  • Workflow: task assignment, draft to review to publish state machines, and admin tooling that lets the businesschange the rules without a deploy.
  • Dashboards and reporting: progress, throughput, and quality visibility for team leads and leadership.
  • APIs and integrations: the services connecting this platform to the rest of our systems.
  • Auth and access control: roles and permissions across an internal product used by several teams.
  • The data layer: schema design, migrations against live data, and keeping queries fast as volume grows.

AI systems

  • Multi-agent extraction pipelines: agent graphs that collect, extract and reconcile data from public sources atscale, including retrieval, prompt and context design, model selection, rate limiting and cost.
  • Human-in-the-loop review tooling: interfaces where a reviewer sees what the AI proposed, the alternatives itrejected, the evidence behind each, and can override the machine with a justification that gets recorded and kept.
  • Audit and provenance: append-only decision trails, so every value can be traced back to a source and to whoeveraccepted it.
  • Data-quality gating: the checks between what a model produces and what reaches a customer, so nothing AI originated lands unchecked.
  • Source onboarding: new collectors and per-source parsers, the business rules that go with them, and the admin tooling behind them.

attributes.functions:
The Senior Business Development Representative (SBDR) is responsible for generating qualified sales opportunities for CrewBloom’s remote staffing solutions through strategic B2B outbound prospecting.

The role focuses on identifying and engaging US-based companies that can benefit from building and scaling remote teams, particularly across Healthcare, Legal, Finance, and other service-based industries. The SBDR will connect with business owners, executives, and other key decision-makers, understand their staffing needs, and convert qualified conversations into Discovery Calls.

This is a hunter-style role requiring strong cold-calling skills, independent prospecting, personalized outreach, and the ability to confidently communicate the business value of remote staffing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect US-based companies that could benefit from remote staffing and workforce solutions.
  • Generate qualified opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels.
  • Engage Founders, Owners, C-Suite executives, VPs, Directors, HR leaders, Operations leaders, and other hiring decision-makers.
  • Understand prospects’ hiring challenges, staffing requirements, operational needs, and potential opportunities for remote talent.
  • Clearly communicate CrewBloom’s value proposition and how remote staffing can support cost efficiency, scalability, and business growth.
  • Personalize outreach based on the prospect’s company, industry, hiring activity, and potential workforce needs.
  • Qualify prospects, handle initial objections, and determine fit before scheduling Discovery Calls.
  • Maintain accurate prospecting activities, follow-ups, and pipeline information in the CRM.
  • Consistently build a high-quality pipeline while balancing outreach volume with personalization and relevance.
